verdict.rationale: React delegates the dev server and build tool to third parties like Vite, Parcel, Rsbuild, or frameworks such as Next.js (react-docs-22, react-docs-4), so it does not own that error experience. Its own build-time tooling does surface errors: React Compiler has a debugging guide separating build-time compiler errors from runtime issues (react-docs-18), and eslint-plugin-react-hooks catches severe bugs early (react-docs-19). Missing for 10: evidence that dev-server or build error messages are clear and actionable, first-party dev server error overlays, and independent or hands-on corroboration of error message quality.
